resolution_rationale: The frozen title and abstract explicitly support software-architecture relevance (I1) and architecture conformance (I2). Study type (I3) remains ambiguous: the abstract poses a feasibility question without identifying an original method, tool, framework, empirical investigation or systematic secondary study. The journal-article label and venue do not establish that criterion. This uncertainty warrants advancement to full text; it does not establish an ineligible study type or justify an exclusion code.
